ops.quote: the self-attention mechanism has recently taken various computer vision areas by storm
we propose a novel linear attention named large kernel attention (LKA)
enable self-adaptive and long-range correlations in self-attention
we present a neural network based on LKA, namely Visual Attention Network (VAN)
VAN surpasses similar size vision transformers(ViTs) and convolutional neural networks(CNNs) in various tasks
VAN-B6 achieves 87.8% accuracy on ImageNet benchmark
set new state-of-the-art performance (58.2 PQ) for panoptic segmentation
VAN-B2 surpasses Swin-T 4% mIoU (50.1 vs. 46.1) for semantic segmentation on ADE20K benchmark
2.6% AP (48.8 vs. 46.2) for object detection on COCO dataset
it provides a novel method and a simple yet strong baseline for the community
